build_UNet_backbone: build a UNet backbone model with configurable encoder decoder stages for biomedical image segmentation
create_BasicConvBlock: create a BasicConvBlock with configurable convolution layers stride and dilation for feature extraction
build_DeconvModule: build a DeconvModule using transposed convolution for 2X upsampling in the UNet decoder
create_InterpConv: create an InterpConv module that combines bilinear interpolation with convolution for upsampling
test_UNet_forward: test the UNet forward pass by passing an input tensor and collecting multi-scale decoder outputs
